protocol.scope: 10-task batch; pilot only; not unseen evaluation
protocol.unit_of_replication: independent context for one 10-task batch, not individual function
protocol.dispatch: serial; exact saved prompt sent inline; one file write and final acknowledgement
protocol.private_evaluation: after all six batch generation/repair loops close; all attempts scored
primary_metrics: all generation/repair output tokens including reasoning
protocol.decision: Report each paired replicate. A practical primary cost advantage requires same final correctness and >=5% median reduction with the same direction in all 3 pairs. Otherwise cost winner is inconclusive. No population-level claim from this pilot.

local_benchmark.selection: preselected first replicate; no best-case selection
local_benchmark.warm_scope: guest harness + imported Wasm solve + per-call expected check; no Python bridge per solve
